Traditional tale: 孟母三迁

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After the cemetery-play sentence, add Mengzi’s feeling to explain why the activity attracts him, for example: “孟子觉得祭拜很有趣。”
2. At the end, add the mother’s worry to make the reason for moving more vivid, for example: “妈妈很担心孟子会学坏。”

ideas.reason: It gives a fitting, simple reason why Mengzi enjoys imitating funeral rituals.
It makes the mother’s reason for moving concrete and matches the traditional tale.
